notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond and Sigil of the Nayan Gods attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
